reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text:
The actual app does nothing what the ad shows it doing. The ONLY way a different price would have shown up for a job is if the user had made a custom item and saved it. Then compared it to a new job. There is no database available in this app that lists available repairs or products. It would ALL have to be custom created by the user of the app. 
 This app is nothing more than an invoice creator or custom estimate tool. Can do the same with any other free app that is properly advertised as a simple invoice/estimate tool. Do not fall for the lies in this company’s false advertising. And yes I did get the premium version to see and possibly use all of the features. I was utterly disappointed with this app and will be deleting it after leaving this review. SAVE YOUR TIME AND YOUR MONEY. 
0⭐️ rating 🤮👎

reviews.title: Scammer Alert !
reviews.text:
At first, the app worked perfectly and did exactly what it was supposed to do. Because of that, I decided to subscribe to the Premium plan to access all features.

However, after a recent update, the app stopped working properly on my phone. The preview function no longer works and only shows a template instead of the actual invoice. The only way to use it properly is by logging in online, which defeats the purpose of having the app.

I contacted support immediately. They acknowledged the issue and said it would be escalated to their engineering team. That was on February 6, and since then we’ve been going back and forth. As of today, May 1, the issue is still not resolved.

I understand that updates can sometimes cause problems, but taking 3 months without a fix is unacceptable—especially for a paid Premium subscription. On top of that, there has been no compensation or solution offered for the time I’ve been unable to use the app properly.

Very disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Misleading Subscription – Charged Without Clear Consent
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app but never used it. There was no clear subscription confirmation or pricing screen, yet I was automatically charged $9.99 per week. The plan name “Week Plus Tofu” is vague and does not indicate it is a paid subscription.

I only discovered the charge when checking my billing history. I canceled immediately, but the refund request was denied with no option to appeal.

The subscription design is extremely unclear and misleading. Please be cautious before downloading this app to avoid unexpected charges like mine.
